name: Julia Gardiner Tyler
bioAdditions: Each generation now sourced in two independent compiled works (Gardiner 1890, S1; Pelletreau 1898, S2): Bull Smith -> Richard 2d -> Nathaniel Smith (b. 30 Jan 1698, d. 30 Mar 1765, patentee of Moriches) -> Mary (b. 3 Oct 1725, m. 12 Jun 1745 Col. Abraham Gardiner) -> Capt. Abraham Gardiner (1763-1796, m. Phoebe Dayton) -> Sen. David Gardiner (1784-1844) -> Julia: 5th cousin 6 times removed. Gardiner (S1) lists her children with President Tyler as David G., John A., Julia, Lachlan, Lyon G., Robert Fitzwalter and Pearl.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Collateral path confirmed in two published genealogies; only John's own Temperance Smith link keeps it below confirmed.

sources.citation: Curtiss C. Gardiner, Lion Gardiner and his Descendants (1890) (archive.org full text), pp. 118-121, 131-132, 148-149
